text: Choose a persistent dark theme with a manual toggle to light mode. This matches Manus’ competitive edge in dark-themed interactivity while giving users control for readability. text: Pane: The real risk isn’t preference—it’s habituation. Users won’t switch from dark mode once they’re locked in, even if light mode later proves better for their task. A better alternative: default to system preference, with a persistent toggle in the settings menu. Settle it with A/B testing—measure task completion time and user retention over two weeks.
